Automated valve test systems

Project Engineer, Dunn's Valve Testers, 2026

DWGVP25&75-10412026

4-Station Valve Test Frame

VP25 & VP75 · Dunn's Valve Testers

Autodesk InventorMachine designSafety guardingDesign release

What

  • Four-station hydraulic test frame that tests 1.5" through 4" NPT and flanged valves side by side.
  • Each station has its own ram, seal-plate interface and safety window, with a shared operating panel, PLC cabinet and back enclosure.

How

  • Engineered the frame and station tooling in Autodesk Inventor.
  • Station-specific top seal plates with O-ring grooves, ram mount and base plates for 5-in and 6-in ram ends, and enclosure brackets.
  • Led the drafting team and reviewed and approved the fabrication drawing package.

Results

  • ~4,900 lb frame released to fabrication with a full general-arrangement and part-drawing package.
  • Dedicated tooling per station for NPT and flanged valves from 1.5" to 4".
DWGRF400-10252026

Large-Valve Hydrostatic Test System

RF400 · Dunn's Valve Testers

System schematicsPLC/HMI electricalHydraulicsWater systems

What

  • Large-bore valve test system: heavy test frame with top and bottom seal plates, a 400-gallon high-volume water skid, hydraulic power unit and HMI control panel.
  • Clamps valves with openings from 12" up to 47¼" and includes valve-exerciser stations.

How

  • Authored the complete 10-sheet system schematic set: test control, machine test circuit, water skid, HPU and machine hydraulics, PLC, HMI, HPU and machine electrical, plus connector and cable schedules.
  • Reviewed and approved the valve-exerciser mounting bracket and extrusion shaft.
  • Coordinated the frame, skid, HPU and control panel as one integrated machine.

Results

  • System approved for manufacture (June 2026).
  • ~40,000 lb test frame integrated with a 4,100 lb water skid, HPU and HMI panel.
DWGRF150-10402026

Hydrostatic Valve Test System

RF150 · Dunn's Valve Testers

Fluid circuit designHPUElectricalSystem integration

What

  • Complete valve test station: ram-clamped test frame, test control panel, 7.5 HP hydraulic power unit with 35 L tank, and water skid.
  • Tests valves with openings from 6" to 40".

How

  • Authored the 4-sheet schematic set: test circuit and control cabinet, water skid with 75-gallon tank, hydraulics, and electrical.
  • Reviewed and approved the general arrangement tying the frame, panel, HPU and water skid together.

Results

  • ~11,000 lb test frame with integrated air, gas and water test supplies, drains and pressure instrumentation.
  • Released schematic and GA package for fabrication.
DWGCVA003-10432026

Pneumatic Valve Test Cabinet

CVA003 · Dunn's Valve Testers

PneumaticsLeak detectionInstrumentation

What

  • Test cabinet for gas and air testing of valves, with bubble-cup leak detection and a flow-meter panel.

How

  • Designed the 2-sheet circuit: gas and air inlets, regulators, relief valves, a diaphragm pump, and a 7-ton clamp cylinder.
  • Laid out a dedicated flow-meter panel for measuring leakage.

Results

  • Complete pneumatic test circuit released for build (Rev B).
DWGRV006-10322026

Locking-Ram Hydrostatic Test Circuit

RV006 · Dunn's Valve Testers

High-pressure hydraulicsInterlocksAccumulators

What

  • High-pressure test circuit for a valve tester clamped by four 30-ton locking ram cylinders.

How

  • Designed the circuit with a 10-gallon, 3,000 psi accumulator, air-pilot-operated interlock valve, pressure relief, and 3K and 10K pressure gauges.
  • Separated air, water and high-pressure supply paths with dedicated drains.

Results

  • Single-sheet circuit released for build (Rev A).

Robotic Humanoid Hand

Texas A&M | Undergraduate research

SolidWorksRaspberry PiPython

What

  • Adapted an open-source biomimetic hand into a cheaper, more accessible design for educational use.

How

  • Designed in SolidWorks and coded on a Raspberry Pi in Python.
  • Wires act as tendons for finger curl; servo motors drive lateral actuation.

Results

  • Low-cost robotic hand for use in engineering classes.
